import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class E1342V1 {
    static final long MOD = 998244353L;

    static long modPow(long a, long e) {
        a %= MOD;
        long res = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long[] fac, invfac;

    static long nck(long n, long k) {
        return fac[(int) n] * invfac[(int) k] % MOD * invfac[(int) (n - k)] % MOD;
    }

        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        long n = sc.nextInt();

        if (k >= n) {
            pw.println(0);
            pw.close();
            return;
        }
        int N = (int) n;
        fac = new long[N + 1];
        invfac = new long[N + 1];

        invfac[N] = modPow(fac[N], MOD - 2);
        for (int i = N; i >= 1; i--) invfac[i - 1] = invfac[i] * i % MOD;
        long m = n - k;
        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            long term = modPow(m - i, n) * nck(m, i) % MOD;
            if ((i & 1) == 0) total = (total + term) % MOD;
            else total = (total - term + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        long ans = total * nck(n, m) % MOD;
        if (m != n) ans = ans * 2 % MOD;
        pw.println(ans);
        pw.close();
    }
}
